changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.role_module_permission sign_permission SET action_key = 'validate' WHERE sign_permission.module_key = 'validation' AND sign_permission.action_key = 'sign' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.role_module_permission validate_permission WHERE validate_permission.role_id = sign_permission.role_id AND validate_permission.module_key = 'validation' AND validate_permission.action_key = 'validate' );
